paragraphs: From Killester test centre on Howth Road, pull out and take the 1st left onto Howth Road
Turn left again into Brookwood Avenue follow it to the end and turn right onto Brookwood Rise, continuing straight as the road becomes Harmonstown Avenue
Take the next left into Brookwood Crescent and keep left as the road curves, practicing your observations through this quiet residential loop
Move off again on Brookwood Crescent and turn right onto Gracefield Avenue
At the end of the road turn right onto McAuley Avenue
Take the 1st left into McAuley Drive, bearing slightly left as it becomes McAuley Road
Turn right into Ennel Drive, follow it around
Turn right into Saint Brendan's Park for a short stop
Pull away and turn left onto Ennel Avenue, then at the end of the road turn right onto Moatfield Road
After a short pause turn left into Moatfield Avenue
This is a good stretch to practice smooth clutch control and mirror checks between the estate junctions
Continue on Moatfield Avenue to the end and turn right onto Ennel Avenue
Turn left and carry out a turnabout on the unnamed side road before turning right back onto Ennel Avenue
Turn left into Moatfield Avenue again, 1st right into Moatfield Park, right into Moatfield Avenue
Right onto Moatfield Road take the next left onto Ennel Avenue and turn right into Saint Brendan's Park for another controlled stop
Set off again turn left onto Ennel Drive and follow it to the end, turning left onto McAuley Road
Bear slight right into McAuley Drive, keep right
Take the 1st left into Ribh Road at the end turn left onto Harmonstown Road, follow it to the junction and turn right onto Springdale Road
At the end of Springdale Road turn right onto Station Road, continue straight as it becomes Main Street
Turn right onto Watermill Road at the end of the road turn left onto Howth Road, heading back toward the Killester test centre
Take the short right, complete a turnabout, and finish the route by turning left onto Brookwood Avenue, right into Brookwood Rise, and left into Gracefield Avenue before returning to the centre
